summary: Deterministic evaluation rules for using and updating the blackhost skill.

using_this_skill.purpose: Checks an agent should run mentally or mechanically before presenting or executing blackhost capabilities.

principles.name: Specificity
principles.rule: Use package manifests as deterministic capability contracts; use CLI discovery only for executable routing.

principles.name: Host respect
principles.rule: Respect the user's existing host setup and avoid hidden host mutations.

principles.name: CLI boundary
principles.rule: Treat blackhost_* functions as internal shell APIs and scripts/core/init.sh as the public CLI entrypoint.

checks.summary: Load skill.json once the user moves past presentation.
checks.deterministic_action: Read skill.json before choosing package-specific files or commands.
checks.passes_when: The agent can name the relevant manifest and command surface from skill.json.

checks.summary: Inspect local generated status before rerunning host checks.
checks.deterministic_action: If local/index.json exists, read it before running dependency checks that might duplicate recent work.
checks.passes_when: The agent can state the latest recorded command, host, package versions, and whether the local index is stale for the current decision.

checks.summary: Open local status HTML through localhost in the system default browser.
checks.deterministic_action: Serve .agents/skills/blackhost/local over 127.0.0.1 and trigger the system default browser for http://localhost:<port>/index.html instead of using file:// navigation or the Codex in-app browser.
checks.passes_when: The system default browser is reviewing the generated status page over localhost and any temporary server is stopped when no longer needed.

checks.summary: Load the package manifest before package-specific work.
checks.deterministic_action: Read manifests/<package>.json before editing or executing package scripts.
checks.passes_when: The agent's action uses the manifest-declared commands, modules, dependencies, and safety metadata.

checks.summary: Map natural-language meta prompts to canonical commands.
checks.deterministic_action: When the user invokes a blackhost meta prompt such as blackhost run php app, map it to the matching command in SKILL.md before executing through scripts/core/init.sh.
checks.passes_when: The agent can name both the user-facing meta prompt and the canonical package command it selected.

checks.summary: Do not mutate the host or workspace without an explicit command path.
checks.deterministic_action: Check the selected command's mutates_host and mutates_workspace values before execution.
checks.passes_when: Mutating commands prompt unless the user requested --yes or an equivalent explicit confirmation.

checks.summary: Prefer dry-run for install, update, and scaffold flows during review.
checks.deterministic_action: Use --dry-run for supported mutating or file-generating commands unless the user clearly asked to apply changes.
checks.passes_when: The command prints intended operations without applying them.

checks.summary: Dry-run should expose the planned host path.
checks.deterministic_action: When --dry-run is supported, keep evaluating the detected host branch even if tooling is already installed or currently missing.
checks.passes_when: The dry-run output includes the package-manager commands that would be run for the detected host.

checks.summary: Use JSON output for machine-readable command status.
checks.deterministic_action: Add --json when an agent needs to branch on command success, failure, package, command, host, or dry-run state.
checks.passes_when: The command appends a blackhost.result object and the agent does not scrape prose for those fields.

updating_this_skill.purpose: Checks an agent should satisfy when changing blackhost architecture, packages, scripts, or schemas.

principles.name: Efficiency
rules: Keep skill.json as a lightweight index for agent ingestion.
Keep repeatable and predictable workflow steps in deterministic scripts.

principles.name: Compatibility
rules: Use established specifications such as JSON-RPC 2.0, MCP, and OpenAPI where applicable, with lightweight extensions for execution and dependency metadata.
Keep shell scripts compatible with macOS default Bash 3.x and modern Bash on Debian/Ubuntu.

checks.summary: Maintenance work follows schemas/maintain.json.
checks.deterministic_action: Read schemas/maintain.json and apply its ordered process when changing packages, routing, schemas, templates, or assurance.
checks.passes_when: The change updates runtime, contracts, schemas, and assurance in the order required by schemas/maintain.json.

checks.summary: SKILL.md frontmatter reflects public capability changes.
checks.deterministic_action: Update SKILL.md YAML frontmatter description when packages or owned tools change.
checks.passes_when: The frontmatter names every public package/tool family exposed by the skill.

checks.summary: SKILL.md Mermaid diagram reflects package architecture.
checks.deterministic_action: Update Mermaid nodes when adding or removing package manifests or changing the routing model.
checks.passes_when: The diagram includes new package manifests and still shows skill.json, core routing, package scripts, and host effects.

checks.summary: Every package has a canonical manifest.
checks.deterministic_action: Create or update manifests/<package>.json from templates/manifest.json.
checks.passes_when: The package manifest has the same top-level key order as core.json: script, summary, modules_dir, modules, commands, routing, dependencies, safety, notes.

checks.summary: Package scripts follow the standard module shape.
checks.deterministic_action: Use templates/scripts/*.sh when creating commons, check, install, update, or scaffold modules.
checks.passes_when: Scripts expose blackhost_<package>_* functions and can be loaded by scripts/core/helpers/run.sh.

checks.summary: Dry-run behavior is consistent across packages and templates.
checks.deterministic_action: Install/update scripts that support --dry-run must print the detected install/update command path without executing it, including when tooling is already installed or currently missing.
checks.passes_when: Dry-run commands exit after printing planned commands and do not depend on the target tooling being absent or present.

checks.summary: Core router exposes the package command surface.
checks.deterministic_action: Preserve convention-based routing from scripts/<package>/*.sh to blackhost_<package>_<command> functions.
checks.passes_when: scripts/core/init.sh <package> --help exits 0, lists commands discovered from scripts/<package>/, and does not require package-specific router case blocks.

checks.summary: Core manifest reflects router changes.
checks.deterministic_action: Update manifests/core.json functions, package list, routing packages, and command grammar.
checks.passes_when: The package appears under commands.package.packages and routing.packages.

checks.summary: Skill index reflects current files and schemas.
checks.deterministic_action: Update skill.json manifest summaries, script summaries, templates, schemas, and eval references.
checks.passes_when: skill.json has no placeholders and points to schemas/eval.json.

checks.summary: Skill version is explicit and semver-compatible.
checks.deterministic_action: Update VERSION when behavior, public capability, routing, schemas, templates, assurance, licensing, or generated-state contracts change, then add a matching CHANGELOG.md row.
checks.passes_when: VERSION exists and contains exactly one semantic version string, including optional prerelease suffix.

checks.summary: Current version has a deterministic changelog row.
checks.deterministic_action: Add one CHANGELOG.md row for the current VERSION with Version, User, LLM, and a summary of 240 characters or fewer.
checks.command: test -f .agents/skills/blackhost/CHANGELOG.md && ruby -e 'version=File.read(".agents/skills/blackhost/VERSION").strip; lines=File.readlines(".agents/skills/blackhost/CHANGELOG.md", chomp: true); header=lines.find { |line| line.start_with?("| Version | User | LLM | 240-Char Summary |") }; raise "missing changelog header" unless header; row=lines.find { |line| line.start_with?("| #{version} |") }; raise "missing changelog row for #{version}" unless row; cells=row.split("|").map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?); raise "expected Version/User/LLM/240-Char Summary" unless cells.length == 4; raise "summary too long" if cells[3].length > 240'
checks.passes_when: CHANGELOG.md has one current-version row with exactly four populated cells and a summary no longer than 240 characters.

checks.summary: Skill licensing is explicit.
checks.deterministic_action: Keep LICENSE.md with the selected license text and required licensor notice.
checks.command: test -f .agents/skills/blackhost/LICENSE.md && rg -q '^Required Notice: Copyright Blackaft Associates \(associates@blackaft\.com\)$' .agents/skills/blackhost/LICENSE.md
checks.passes_when: LICENSE.md exists and includes the required Blackaft Associates notice.

checks.summary: System default browser review path for local/index.html stays explicit and routed.
checks.deterministic_action: Keep SKILL.md explicit that routed commands open local/index.html over localhost in the system default browser, while assurance disables repeated browser openings.
checks.command: rg -q 'Every routed command refreshes' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md && rg -q 'python3 -m webbrowser http://localhost:8765/index\.html' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md && rg -q 'system default browser' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md && rg -q 'file://' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md && rg -q 'blackhost_index_open_html' .agents/skills/blackhost/scripts/core/helpers/run.sh && rg -q 'BLACKHOST_OPEN_INDEX=false' .agents/skills/blackhost/assurance/eval.sh && rg -q 'BLACKHOST_OPEN_INDEX=false' .agents/skills/blackhost/assurance/dry.sh
checks.passes_when: SKILL.md contains the default-browser command, localhost status page URL, file:// avoidance note, and the router calls the status-page opener with assurance disabled.

checks.summary: Capability table includes explicit meta prompts.
checks.deterministic_action: Keep the SKILL.md capabilities table explicit about natural-language meta prompts and their canonical command mapping.
checks.command: rg -q '\| Capability \| Meta Prompt \| Command \| Manifest \| Mutates host \|' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md && rg -q 'blackhost run php app' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md && rg -q 'blackhost install docker' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md
checks.passes_when: SKILL.md exposes the Meta Prompt column and representative package mappings.

checks.summary: Skill instructions do not contain unresolved TODO notes.
checks.deterministic_action: Remove unresolved TODO markers from SKILL.md before completion.
checks.passes_when: No TODO or FIXME markers remain in SKILL.md.

checks.summary: OpenAPI projection reflects public operation changes.
checks.deterministic_action: Update schemas/skill.openapi.yml when adding, removing, or renaming public commands.
checks.passes_when: The YAML parses and exposes paths for each public operation.

checks.summary: Static files parse and shell scripts compile.
commands: for file in .agents/skills/blackhost/manifests/*.json .agents/skills/blackhost/templates/*.json; do python3 -m json.tool "$file" >/dev/null || exit 1; done

test -f .agents/skills/blackhost/CHANGELOG.md && ruby -e 'version=File.read(".agents/skills/blackhost/VERSION").strip; lines=File.readlines(".agents/skills/blackhost/CHANGELOG.md", chomp: true); header=lines.find { |line| line.start_with?("| Version | User | LLM | 240-Char Summary |") }; raise "missing changelog header" unless header; row=lines.find { |line| line.start_with?("| #{version} |") }; raise "missing changelog row for #{version}" unless row; cells=row.split("|").map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?); raise "expected Version/User/LLM/240-Char Summary" unless cells.length == 4; raise "summary too long" if cells[3].length > 240'
test -f .agents/skills/blackhost/LICENSE.md && rg -q '^Required Notice: Copyright Blackaft Associates \(associates@blackaft\.com\)$' .agents/skills/blackhost/LICENSE.md

ruby -ryaml -e 'front=File.read(".agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md").split("---",3)[1]; desc=YAML.safe_load(front).fetch("description"); ["AWS CLI", "Google Cloud CLI", "Homebrew", "Node.js"].each { |needle| raise "frontmatter missing #{needle}" unless desc.include?(needle) }'

rg -q 'Every routed command refreshes' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md && rg -q 'python3 -m webbrowser http://localhost:8765/index\.html' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md && rg -q 'system default browser' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md && rg -q 'file://' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md && rg -q 'blackhost_index_open_html' .agents/skills/blackhost/scripts/core/helpers/run.sh && rg -q 'BLACKHOST_OPEN_INDEX=false' .agents/skills/blackhost/assurance/eval.sh && rg -q 'BLACKHOST_OPEN_INDEX=false' .agents/skills/blackhost/assurance/dry.sh

rg -q '\| Capability \| Meta Prompt \| Command \| Manifest \| Mutates host \|' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md && rg -q 'blackhost run php app' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md && rg -q 'blackhost install docker' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md && rg -q 'blackhost auth aws' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md && rg -q 'blackhost install homebrew' .agents/skills/blackhost/SKILL.md

ruby -rjson -e 'root=".agents/skills/blackhost"; packages=Dir.children(File.join(root,"scripts")).select { |name| File.directory?(File.join(root,"scripts",name)) && name != "core" }.sort; required=%w[script summary modules_dir modules commands routing dependencies safety notes]; skill=JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(root,"skill.json"))).fetch("blackhost/"); scripts=skill.fetch("scripts/"); core=JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(root,"manifests/core.json"))); core_packages=core.fetch("commands").fetch("package").fetch("packages"); routing=core.fetch("routing").fetch("packages"); packages.each { |package| manifest_path=File.join(root,"manifests","#{package}.json"); raise "missing manifest for #{package}" unless File.file?(manifest_path); manifest=JSON.parse(File.read(manifest_path)); missing=required.reject { |key| manifest.key?(key) }; raise "#{package} manifest missing #{missing.join(", ")}" unless missing.empty?; raise "skill.json missing scripts/#{package}/" unless scripts.key?("#{package}/"); raise "core package list missing #{package}" unless core_packages.include?(package); raise "core routing missing #{package}" unless routing.key?(package) }'

ruby -ryaml -e 'root=".agents/skills/blackhost"; api=YAML.load_file(File.join(root,"schemas/skill.openapi.yml")); enum=api.fetch("paths").fetch("/manifests/{manifestName}").fetch("get").fetch("parameters")[0].fetch("schema").fetch("enum"); paths=api.fetch("paths").keys; manifests=api.fetch("x-blackhost").fetch("manifests"); filesystem_manifests=api.fetch("x-blackhost").fetch("filesystem").fetch("blackhost/").fetch("manifests/"); packages=Dir.children(File.join(root,"scripts")).select { |name| File.directory?(File.join(root,"scripts",name)) && name != "core" }.sort; packages.each { |package| raise "#{package} missing from manifest enum" unless enum.include?(package); raise "#{package} missing from x-blackhost manifests" unless manifests.key?(package); raise "#{package}.json missing from x-blackhost filesystem map" unless filesystem_manifests.key?("#{package}.json"); Dir.children(File.join(root,"scripts",package)).grep(/\.sh$/).map { |file| File.basename(file,".sh") }.reject { |cmd| cmd == "commons" }.sort.each { |command| path="/packages/#{package}/#{command}"; raise "missing #{path}" unless paths.include?(path) } }'
for file in $(find .agents/skills/blackhost -path .agents/skills/blackhost/local -prune -o -type f -name "*.sh" -print | sort); do bash -n "$file" || exit 1; done
checks.passes_when: All commands exit 0.

checks.summary: Public routing still works.
checks.passes_when: All commands exit 0.

checks.summary: Local index artifacts render after command runs.
checks.command: bash .agents/skills/blackhost/scripts/core/init.sh --json os >/dev/null && python3 -m json.tool .agents/skills/blackhost/local/index.json >/dev/null && python3 -c 'import json, sys; data=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); packages=data["packages"]; assert all(name in packages["node"]["tools"] for name in ("node", "npm", "npx")); assert "aws" in packages and "aws" in packages["aws"]["tools"]; assert "gcloud" in packages and "gcloud" in packages["gcloud"]["tools"]; assert "homebrew" in packages and "brew" in packages["homebrew"]["tools"]' .agents/skills/blackhost/local/index.json && test -f .agents/skills/blackhost/local/index.html && rg -q 'Node.jsnode' .agents/skills/blackhost/local/index.html && rg -q 'AWS CLIaws' .agents/skills/blackhost/local/index.html && rg -q 'Google Cloud CLIgcloud' .agents/skills/blackhost/local/index.html && rg -q 'Homebrewbrew' .agents/skills/blackhost/local/index.html
checks.passes_when: local/index.json parses, local/index.html exists, and Node.js/npm/npx, AWS CLI, Google Cloud CLI, and Homebrew appear in generated local status artifacts after a routed command.

checks.summary: Local status HTML includes the latest assurance log section.
checks.command:
bash .agents/skills/blackhost/scripts/core/init.sh --json os >/dev/null && rg -q '

Assurance Log

' .agents/skills/blackhost/local/index.html && rg -q 'assurance/log.txt' .agents/skills/blackhost/local/index.html
checks.passes_when: local/index.html contains a readable raw assurance log section after a routed command.

checks.summary: Assurance log is overwritten on each assurance run.
checks.passes_when: assurance/log.txt exists and is non-empty after assurance/eval.sh.

checks.summary: Executable assurance passes.
checks.passes_when: The command exits 0.

checks.summary: Skill creator validator passes when the blackhost YAML venv is installed.
checks.passes_when: The command exits 0; fresh checkouts without the generated venv skip this local-only validator.

checks.summary: Removed shortcut and state-module architecture stays removed.
checks.passes_when: The command exits 0 with no matches.
